title.narrative: Building Voices for Accountability (BVA)

description.narrative:
The project aims to empower civil society in Solomon Islands to engage as actors of governance and development by advancing human rights issues, influencing policy and decision-making processes and holding the Government accountable for its performance towards citizens and society at large.

It will do so by building the capacity of CSOs to pursue accountability and transparency and by strengthening the capacity of public interest media to foster freedom of expression.
